name: dump1090 over Mode S
why: The one adapter that takes IQ straight off the root with no tuner and no demodulator in front of it, at a sample rate it will not negotiate. It pins two things that were wrong when the adapter was written from documentation: the program is installed as dump1090-mutability or dump1090-fa on the distributions that ship it, and --quiet does not mean 'no banner', it means 'no stdout' — which is where --raw puts the decodes.

expect.note: Both frames carry a correct 24-bit Mode S parity, which dump1090 checks before it will believe either of them — so this is also a check that the fixture generator's CRC is right.
